title: macOS Dock badge and deep links
description: Start a packaged test app with profile temp/desktop-links/profile, CDP9497 and main inspector9498. Set gateway credentials and real FARMSLOT_TEST_RUN_ID/FARMSLOT_TEST_SLOT_ID values. The gateway must have pending decisions. Uses real login, macOS URL delivery, gateway reads and native Dock/menu APIs; never resolves decisions or changes task state.

desktop-links.intent: Links survive connection setup, open real run and slot views, restore hidden/minimized windows and work on cold launch. The native Dock badge matches gateway pending decisions, clears when disconnected, and the native menu copies only an entity link.
